         return orjson.dumps(

         )
+
+
+class SSEResponse(StreamingResponse):
+    """SSE response for Server-Sent Events.
+
+    This response class automatically sets the required headers for SSE
+    and formats the streamed content as `data: <message>
+
+`.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        content: Any,
+        status_code: int = 200,
+        headers: dict[str, str] | None = None,
+        background: Any = None,
+    ):
+        if headers is None:
+            headers = {}
+        headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache"
+        headers["Connection"] = "keep-alive"
+
+        async def wrapper():
+            if hasattr(content, "__aiter__"):
+                async for item in content:
+                    yield SSEResponse.format_sse_item(item)
+            elif hasattr(content, "__iter__"):
+                for item in content:
+                    yield SSEResponse.format_sse_item(item)
+            else:
+                yield SSEResponse.format_sse_item(content)
+
+        super().__init__(
+            content=wrapper(),
+            status_code=status_code,
+            headers=headers,
+            background=background,
+            media_type="text/event-stream",
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def format_sse_item(item: Any) -> str:
+        if isinstance(item, dict) and ("data" in item or "event" in item or "id" in item):
+            lines = []
+            if "data" in item:
+                data = item["data"]
+                if not isinstance(data, str):
+                    data = json.dumps(jsonable_encoder(data))
+                lines.append(f"data: {data}")
+            if "event" in item:
+                lines.append(f"event: {item['event']}")
+            if "id" in item:
+                lines.append(f"id: {item['id']}")
+            return "\n".join(lines) + "\n\n"
+
+        if isinstance(item, str):
+            return f"data: {item}\n\n"
+        return f"data: {json.dumps(jsonable_encoder(item))}\n\n"
